question:

GPK ∶ MSI ∶∶ RHT ∶ VKT ∶∶ IDW ∶ ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• GPK ∶ MSI

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6fc27f79145cbb2f2f6ea747a82593d3562524c1645de1bfdefc6429e17439f.png] 

and

 
• RHT ∶ VKT

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6102c4bb8abf8ff4a9809243ad2c39586978400485a5f2c5cc2eb1fa0731c48c.png] 

Similarly,

 
• IDW ∶ ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ea9ce178107ae596bcbed5745a523b744fced3503267e97e2c7bda6eb7525af7.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"YGK".**
